artifact_binding.rule: before execution, resolve the unique active case_id and variant_id candidate, require candidate_revision 1.0.1, and require its input_sha256 to equal the invocation source hash; failed_candidates and superseded revisions are never selectable

title: serial preparation steps

rules: steps execute strictly in ascending SEQ order
SERVICE cannot start before INSPECT completes
MissionPreparation.DURN is deliberately 45 minutes; TaskBreakDown must determine the effective 30-minute work and must not add to it

failure.message: Preparation duration (DURN) is longer than or equal to the notice period (NOPER) of the mission type

failed_candidate_revisions.retention_rule: retain the original input and hash as immutable failed evidence; never select it for acceptance

expected_assertions.assert: revision 1.0.1 notifies at 420; INSPECT runs [420,430) and SERVICE runs [430,450)
step starts and completions preserve SEQ 1 then 2
preparation completes at 450; the deliberately different 45-minute scalar DURN is overridden by, and not added to, the 30-minute breakdown
aircraft remains prepared until planned launch at 480; launch occurs no earlier than 480
per-step work is observable or the case remains blocked rather than inferred from total duration

limitations: TaskBreakDown establishes strict serial work only; it does not establish arbitrary parallel task graphs
